remarks: Drive up this quiet lane to your tranquil piece of paradise.This home is set on sprawling lawns with mature trees and porches overlooking the grounds and the tucked-away pool and poolhouse.Wake up to coffee off the primary bedroom,enjoy drinks on the porch,in the sun room or by the pool.Work from home in the quiet office with fireplace. Gather in the kitchen with large island while you make your favorite meal for friends and family. Dine al fresco under the stars or in the large dining room meant for entertaining. The family room with stone fireplace and built ins is great for large groups and there is even a balcony to enjoy a cigar on.The living room with fireplace is a great place to read a book.Retire to the primary suite with spa bath.The three bedrooms on the second floor share a hall bath.The lower level has a guest room,full bath, and a large rec room with fireplace that is perfect for playing games.Walk out to the yard, up to the pool,or up to the patio off the sunroom. This home was made for entertaining inside and out.The pool area has a separate pool house with kitchen and full bath.The first floor has a large open room and there is room for a big sleep over upstairs. This would also be a great set up for inlaws or guests. The neighborhood is great for running, walking, biking and borders Millstone farm. Enjoy award-winning schools and all Fairfield County has to offer.You will love living on & won't want to leave this mini estate
